input.title: [Android] Caret appear on last known position when user applies Text Color at a focus/cursor level
input.body: ``` - A - B - C - D ``` ## Step to Reproduce 1. Place the caret on Thought A 2. Tap the bullet of Thought D 3. Tap Text Color 4. Apply Red Font Color ## Current behavior Caret appears blinking on Thought A but focus / cursor remains still on Thought D. Keyboard is shown following the appearance of caret. This also reproducible on applying any Background Color https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9183eaa8-d33f-472e-977d-287de5ceb220 ## Expected behavior Caret should not appear when user applies Font nor Background Color a focus / cursor.
